g.text: Urban Balochistan earnings rise with age, but the 60-64 peak rests on only 16 workers
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file merged with household file. Sample: Balochistan urban earners aged 15-64 with earn_annual > 0 (n = 486).
Band means (large markers) weighted by hhweight; hollow markers = bands with fewer than 30 observations.
